definitions.primary_endpoint: Paired board-level success, replicate 1, raw vs local within size; exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs; Holm across sizes.
definitions.nonforced_cell_accuracy: Share of model-called (menu > 1) cell decisions whose chosen cell is extendable; chance = mean of extendable options / menu size.
definitions.calibration: Selected-option probability normalized by the response's probability sum; ten equal-width bins, last bin closed; ECE weighted by bin count; multiclass Brier over the menu with extendable options as positives.
definitions.evaluable: Trajectories not stopped by request_failure, censored_guard or in_progress (acknowledged or not). Puzzle failures (local_rule_violation, globally_unextendable_prefix, no_locally_legal_cell, invalid_complete) are evaluable failures.
definitions.intervals: Clopper-Pearson 95% for board solve rates and for the local share of discordant pairs.
